definition: Distinct Metadata_JCP2022 IDs represented in well.csv.gz, excluding canonical negcon and empty IDs; positive-control perturbations retained. Modalities are disjoint. ORF constructs and nonmissing annotated gene/locus IDs are counted separately. Empty, NA, nan and None identifiers are excluded from the gene/locus count; supplied XLOC annotations and the eGFP positive-control annotation are retained.
